A1.justification: Both PDFs describe SAFREE and provide readable main text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices. Relocated and renumbered material can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v1 reports original safety and generation-quality evaluations, component ablations, artist-style removal experiments, and video-generation results in Tables 1–6.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the ablations and image/video evaluations, with some tables renumbered.

M1.justification: The masked-token selection, selective projection, self-validating timestep control, and Fourier-domain latent re-attention procedures are retained. Separating self-validating filtering into Section 3.3 and explaining Equation (5) token by token do not introduce a new component.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same five adversarial-prompt datasets, COCO, two artist-style datasets, and SafeSora categories. The image and video backbone coverage also remains unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains ESD, SA, CA, MACE, SDID, UCE, RECE, and the same SLD variants. The artist-removal and efficiency comparisons also retain their comparator sets. Newly cited attribute-control methods are discussed but not evaluated.

E3.justification: The reported metrics and procedures remain unchanged, including 1,000 COCO samples for FID/TIFA, GPT-4o assessment using 16 video frames, and the A6000/100-step efficiency comparison. Removed subset and sample-count disclosures do not establish changed experimental settings.

E4.justification: The component ablation is unchanged in v1 Table 3 and v2 Table 2. The toxicity-distance analysis moves from v1 Section 3.1/Figure 3 to v2 Appendix B/Figure 4; it is not a new analysis. The qualitative case studies are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions use the same point-estimate reporting and distance-distribution visualization. Neither adds repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or statistical significance tests.

E6.justification: All six matched quantitative tables retain their numerical results, including SAFREE's P4D ASR of 0.384 and COCO FID of 36.35 in Table 1. The qualitative examples and findings are also retained; altered image compression or masking does not constitute new results.

T1.justification: Equation (2) changes the product Cz to zC, although C is D-by-K and z is K-dimensional. This introduces a localized dimensional inconsistency. The solution for z and the subsequent projection derivation remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The second introduction contribution now explicitly claims better visual quality than training-based methods alongside competitive safeguarding results. The central training-free, adaptive, cross-backbone claims, abstract, and conclusion otherwise retain their meaning.

C2.justification: v2 Appendix E removes v1 Appendix C's explicit image-to-video failure limitation while retaining the warning about implicit and chain-of-thought prompts. No corresponding remedy is reported. The other principal interpretations of the results remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v2 substantially reduces reproducibility detail in Appendix A: it removes the per-benchmark prompt counts, the P4D-N-16 subset identifier, artist-dataset sample counts, and decoder-stage settings s1=0.9 and s2=0.2. It adds a reproducibility statement reporting supplementary code, but the omitted settings are not restored elsewhere in the PDF. These are disclosure changes, not demonstrated changes to the experiments.

R1.justification: New Appendix D distinguishes SAFREE from the attribute-control approaches of Baumann et al. (2024) and Zarei et al. (2024). Background generation and jailbreak citations expand, while references to ConceptPrune, pruning-based robust concept erasing, and Yu et al.'s image-to-video work are removed. The principal safeguard positioning remains intact.

P1.justification: v2 makes targeted prose edits, clarifies token-wise projection, gives self-validating filtering its own subsection, and reorganizes the appendices. It also adds reproducibility and attribute-control discussion sections and updates the publication header. Most methodological and experimental prose remains closely matched.

P2.justification: Existing displays are rearranged: Figure 1 precedes the abstract, the toxicity-distance plot moves to the appendix, and the artist, ablation, and efficiency tables are relocated and renumbered. Some figures are resized and captions or masking adjusted, while the underlying display designs, axes, and table structures remain largely unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 improves method organization and related-work context and reports supplementary code. However, it removes concrete experimental and implementation specifications, omits the image-to-video failure boundary, and introduces the dimensional error in Equation (2). These losses modestly weaken reproducibility and precision, outweighing the limited editorial gains while the method and empirical support remain unchanged.
